newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City plans 40 superstores in NYC.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City plans 40 superstores in NYC.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc said it plans to open 40 superstores by the end of 1999 in New York City, including about 15 of those in 1997.
The Richmond, Virginia-based retailer of consumer electronics and personal computers said the New York openings will create as many as 1,500 jobs.

The company -- with 429 superstores, five comsumer-electronics only stores, 47 mall-based Circuit City Express stores and six CarMax Superstores in the U.S. -- also said it would manage all of its Northeast U.S. operations from New York. The company has 44 stores in all in the Northeast U.S., it said.
The company did not say what it would spend to open the stores or how much it expected them to contribute to its earnings. Officials from Circuit City were not immediately available to comment.
